metric_definitions.bits_per_token: negative mean generated-token log probability in base 2
metric_definitions.coverage_error: RMSE over rare-pair marginal frequencies only, matching the paper's rare-concept coverage framing
metric_definitions.coverage_error_all_features_diagnostic: RMSE over all relevant circuit features; diagnostic only
metric_definitions.distributional_drift_kl: macro Bernoulli KL in nats between realized semantic marginals and the target circuit marginals
metric_definitions.fact_coverage: recall of plan facts explicitly realized in text; extra diagnostic
metric_definitions.factuality_precision: precision of extractable generated facts against the semantic plan; fact-level rather than term-level matching
metric_definitions.jensen_shannon: macro mean base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence over semantic attribute/relation Bernoulli marginals
metric_definitions.perplexity: exp(mean token negative log likelihood); mathematically equivalent to 2**BPT for the same token log probabilities
metric_definitions.rare_combination_coverage: fraction of configured rare-pair features observed at least once
metric_definitions.schema_validity: realized-output hard validity: valid plan/schema plus plan-text consistency, required semantic terms, and FSA acceptance when constrained
metric_definitions.term_factuality_precision_diagnostic: legacy term-level precision retained only as a diagnostic

paper_alignment_note.kl: The paper labels ablation drift as KL without enough implementation detail to reconstruct its exact estimator; this report uses an explicit macro Bernoulli marginal KL and records the definition.
paper_alignment_note.ppl: The paper lists both BPT and PPL but does not specify a separate PPL protocol; this implementation uses the standard perplexity implied by the same token log probabilities.
